name: Elpis: Fallen Star
storyline:
As the leader of an exploration squad, you will face an epic battle against the Demon King! Dive into the world of a semi-RTS RPG!

"You are the chosen leader."

The weight of fate now rests on your shoulders. This is your moment to take command, rally your allies, and carve a path into the unknown! Are you ready? Set sail and good luck!

She is beyond reach.
A worthy enemy. A haunting beauty. A synonym of fear. Now she stands before you. Can you see her true colors? The fate-defining moment is upon you...Elpis: Fallen Star – A Grand Adventure for Those Who Brave the Abyss
As the leader of an exploration squad, you will face an epic battle against the Demon King! Dive into the world of a semi-RTS RPG!

"You are the chosen leader."
The weight of fate now rests on your shoulders. This is your moment to take command, rally your allies, and carve a path into the unknown! Are you ready? Set sail and good luck!

As the leader of the exploration squad, strategize to move forward and deepen bonds with your friends to create an epic journey together. Charge headlong into every challenge, or take a respite from setbacks before rising again with renewed courage? Every choice you make will shake the world!
Gate to the Abyss Opens Here
Mishap Unleashed
Bottomless rifts tear the land, spewing forth unspeakable corruption!
The Abyss expands with terrifying speed. Who is behind this? Could it be her?

Survival hangs by a thread in this merciless wasteland. One misstep could cost your life. Left in a dead end, you cross paths with Agnes and a pink-haired girl with twin tails. What will this encounter bring? Anyway, this ramshackle squad is ready to set off!

Peril Lurks in the Abyss... But So Does Exquisite Cuisine
What's the key to survival? Fresh water? Repellent Powder? No, the answer is Sanity.
Thanks to master chef Monica's four meals daily, your mind stays sharp and your Sanity full!

Use the Leader Skill to Turn the Tide!
Command a squad of up to 8 members and dive into the fray! Remember no enemy is invincible as long as you're prepared. Activate the "Total Assault" and crush them with the combined might of four classes!

A saga of hope and courage awaits. Will you answer the call?
summary:
Elpis: Fallen Star A Grand Adventure for Those Who Brave the Abyss
Have your decision-making tested in the semi-RTS game where strategy forges a road ahead! Meticulous pre-battle planning and orders given in the midst of it are equally critical to the battle!

Pull and invest in your desired characters. The bonds you forge will build a force that can reshape the world one day. Who do you choose? And how to combine their strengths? Your leadership faces a tough trial.

As the leader of the exploration squad, strategize to move forward and deepen bonds with your friends to create an epic journey together. Charge headlong into every challenge, or take a respite from setbacks before rising again with renewed courage? Every choice you make will shake the world!
